name: plan05-pin-private-rollback
objective: v2.3 plan 05, the deterministic half of the J5.6 variant: a PINNED private `[hiding]` fact, planted from a real message, is in the drafted member's private block — and after that message is EDITED it is gone from the block (quarantined, excluded, not ranked lower), and the author's reconfirmation brings it back. The assertion is scoped to the private block itself, because a whole-prompt search passes on the shared transcript — the J5.8 false positive, measured on 2026-09-22. Extraction is mocked (the parser has its own live suites); the mechanism under test is the quarantine, the per-member staging and the injection. The real-LLM variant of this check is plan 05's live recipe, and this file must never stand in for it.

steps.eval: const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; for (const key of Object.keys(globalThis).filter((k) => k.startsWith('storyOrchestratorDebug'))) delete globalThis[key]; rt.setExtractionSettings({ cadence: 0 }); rt.setEpistemicLedgerCapable(true); if (!rt.getSnapshot().memory.settings.epistemicLedgerCapable) throw new Error('the epistemic/ledger capability did not stick'); return { cadence: 0, capable: true };

steps.send: I count the guild's takings while Ponticius is looking at the board.

extract.debugResponse:
SCENE_NONE
[hiding] Arin from Ponticius | Arin palmed the guild's petty cash while nobody was counting.

steps.eval: const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const rows = rt.getEpistemic().filter((entry) => entry.hiddenFrom === 'Ponticius' && !entry.supersededBy); if (rows.length !== 1) throw new Error(`the private fact did not land exactly once: ${JSON.stringify(rt.getEpistemic().map((e) => [e.tag, e.subject, e.hiddenFrom, e.content]))}`); const row = rows[0]; if (row.provenance?.validity !== 'live') throw new Error(`the planted private row is not live: ${JSON.stringify(row.provenance)}`); rt.setEpistemicPinned(row.id, true); const pinned = rt.getEpistemic().find((entry) => entry.id === row.id); if (!pinned?.pinned) throw new Error(`the pin did not stick: ${JSON.stringify(pinned)}`); const engineLast = rt.getEngineState().lastMessageId; if (row.messageId !== engineLast) throw new Error(`the private row's source message is ${row.messageId} but the engine's last consumed message is ${engineLast}: the edit below must name the message that carries it, so this refuses rather than editing the wrong one`); return { id: row.id, tag: row.tag, subject: row.subject, hiddenFrom: row.hiddenFrom, messageId: row.messageId };

[]).map((c) => c?.name))}`); rt.onMemberDrafted(chid); const block = rt.getAppliedEpistemicBlock(); if (!String(block).includes('petty cash')) throw new Error(`drafting Arin did not stage his private block: ${JSON.stringify(String(block).slice(0, 400))}`); return { chid, staged: true };

edit.text: I keep my hands off the guild's takings and say nothing.

An expect.payloadAbsent cannot express this case and REFUSES to by design, because the quarantine leaves the member with no private knowledge at all, so the block is CLEARED rather than present-without-the-text -- and a missing block must never read as an absent needle' };
